about_the_game:
Welcome to Agora: The Future of Digital Board Gaming

Step into Agora, a social-driven board game platform that connects players and independent studios in immersive 3D environments. Discover unique games, meet new friends, and enjoy seamless digital gameplay.

Key Features:

🎲 Play Unique Board Games – Explore a curated selection of independent titles with built-in rule enforcement for smooth gameplay.

🌍 Immersive 3D Environments – Play in stunning, game-specific settings that enhance every match.

🗣️ Social-First Gaming – Join voice channels, meet new friends, and recreate the magic of in-person board game nights.

🛒 Support Independent Studios – Discover and support innovative board game creators.

🎭 Express Yourself – Customize your avatar with unique skins and accessories.

🔥 Free – Play for free alone or with some friends!

Why Choose Agora?

Unlike other platforms, Agora prioritizes quality with immersive 3D environments, automated rules, and strong social features. Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer, Agora is the ultimate destination for digital board gaming.

🚀 Join the Beta Today and Be Part of the Future of Board Gaming!
